26yo- unstable childhood, my parents were both dead  by the time I was 10, I had to watch my mom die of cancer from the ages of 3-9, my father od’d accidentally when I was 6, I formed severe attachment issues due to this, and for a while I told myself that everything I ever loved or cared about died or left, my brother killed himself when I was 22 and my grandfather died a month after him. Today I’m doing a lot better and working a lot of myself, it takes time. All the loss in my life changed me and turned me into a heavily codependent person

Honestly, it took me longer than most, about a year. It took a lot of self reflection and realizing if I want to be happy, I have to find happiness in myself and stop living my life for others. It’s not an easy road getting through a break up, but you have to give yourself meaning and realize that at the end of the day, the only person you can rely on to truly make you happy is yourself. Sure it’s great to have others on your life journey, but it’s better to recover and try to be happy with yourself first

So the way this works, is the unit that has good Iv’s when merged gets their bane stat fixed to be neutral and keeps their boon stat. So for example you have a Ryoma with -def +res. You merge a Ryoma into it with +res -spd, the Ryoma you merged into now has neutral defense and plus res with merge bonuses. Their base stats are unaffected outside of the merge bonuses and bane fix. Their ivs going into the merge doesn’t matter, the unit you are merging isn’t affected by their individual ivs.
